answer.reason: The verses tell of David's capture of the stronghold, the ark brought into it, and the burials of the kings there.

clauses.english: was taken by David from the Jebusites as the stronghold of Zion
clauses.quote: David took the strong hold of Zion: the same is the city of David.

clauses.english: received the ark of God, brought in by David with gladness
clauses.quote: into the city of David with gladness

clauses.english: was the burial place of David and of many kings of Judah after him
clauses.quote: David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.

doubts: ISA 29:1 (Ariel, the city where David dwelt) is a prophetic woe and does not use the name 'city of David', so it was left out.
2CH 25:28 reads 'city of Judah' and was not used.
